function.name: add_item
function.description: Add a menu item to the customer's cart. Use item_term for natural language (e.g. 'everything bagel', 'cream cheese sandwich'). Pass requested_modifiers as spoken by the customer.

item_term.description: Menu item name or description from the customer.

item_id.description: Exact menu item id when already disambiguated.

special_instructions.description: Special prep notes for this line.

function.name: remove_item
function.description: Remove a line from the cart by line_id.

function.name: set_modifier
function.description: Replace modifiers on an existing cart line (after clarification).

function.name: get_cart
function.description: Get the current cart with spoken_summary for read-back. Always use before confirming the order.

function.name: check_ambiguity
function.description: Check if a customer phrase matches multiple menu categories before adding items.

function.name: checkout
function.description: Finalize the order after customer confirms. Requires a non-empty cart.

customer_phone.description: Customer phone for order lookup (optional at pickup).
